summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (39 passed) using the prepared venv. Nothing was committed. mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading the code only. Non-node inputs (None, plain string) were checked manually and raise SHACLPathError with the graph unchanged; they are not in the parametrized test. The pytest.raises line has no type-ignore because isinstance narrows the type there; if mypy reports it, add the comment.
